parsedVerdict.reasoning: TicketController is a presentation-layer file, and nearly all of it fits that role. Its constructor takes BoxOffice and GateLog from the business layer, which this layer may depend on, so that is normal dependency wiring. scan() and events() pass calls through to business services, and the euros() helper only formats money for display. The problem is buy(). It decides how many seats one purchase may contain (between 1 and 8) and rejects the purchase with the domain's own error, TicketRejected. That is a business policy, not a check on the shape of the request. A seat-count limit per purchase is a domain invariant, so BoxOffice.purchase or another business-layer class should own it. The candidate flags point at the same lines (23-29), and the source confirms them.
